title: When the Confession Sings
author: Marguerite Eriksen
blurb: Rosalind Underhill, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
